summary: First-iteration full-stack testing of Pawsome Pet Care. Backend: 29/29 pytest cases passed covering auth (login/me/invalid), all public content endpoints (services, packages, testimonials, faqs, gallery, navigation, settings, homepage, about), service/package detail by slug, public enquiry creation + admin visibility, WhatsApp mock (send-test + logs), ERP booking webhook (secret validation + duplicate prevention), full services CRUD lifecycle (create/get/update/publish/duplicate/reorder/delete/404), singleton updates (settings incl. cta.erp_booking_url reflected on /api/public/settings, contact phone, homepage, about), media upload+delete, dashboard stats. Frontend: home + /about /services /packages /gallery /contact /faq /services/boarding /packages/weekend-getaway all render with content. Floating WhatsApp (wa.me/15551234567) and tel: buttons present. Book Now is <button> with JS click handler (opens ERP url from settings) — not a booking form, as required. Enquiry form on /contact submitted successfully and shows 'Thank you! We've received your enquiry' toast; enquiry appears in Admin > Enquiries. Admin login works, dashboard shows stats + recent enquiries; services list shows 6 edit buttons; WhatsApp Logs Send Test executed.

issues: Browser tab title is 'Emergent | Fullstack App' (default). Consider setting a proper document.title / react-helmet for SEO + branding.

action_items: Minor: Update HTML document title from default 'Emergent | Fullstack App' to a branded/dynamic per-page title.

Minor code review: CORS is configured with allow_origins='*' AND allow_credentials=True. Browsers reject wildcard with credentials; if cookie-based auth from cross-origin is required, set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly. Bearer-token flow is unaffected.
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py get_current_admin falls back to Bearer token (good). Login also returns token in body (good) — frontend can use either mechanism.
whatsapp.py duplicate prevention keys on ref_id+message_type with status in {sent,delivered,read} — verified working end-to-end for both enquiry_received and booking_confirmation.
server.py register_collection uses payload: dict without pydantic validation — acceptable for a CMS admin, but consider explicit models per resource to prevent shape drift.
CORS: allow_origins='*' + allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per spec; if httpOnly cookie auth from a different origin is required, replace '*' with explicit list.
test_credentials: Admin zenlogicglobal@gmail.com / PawsAdmin@2026; ERP webhook secret 'erp-webhook-secret-change-me'.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_ prefixed data via automated tests: TEST_Enquirer (public API), TEST_UI_User (UI enquiry), TEST_Service (created, updated, duplicated, both deleted), TEST_BK_* booking webhook logs (persist in whatsapp_logs). Settings values were mutated (cta.erp_booking_url, phone) during tests — main agent may re-seed if pristine defaults desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (29 tests, runs in ~4s with xdist). Uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Admin data-testids verified: login-email, login-password, login-submit, sidebar-services, sidebar-enquiries, sidebar-whatsapp-logs, edit-{id}. Settings page uses testid settings-cta-nested-erp_booking_url and save-settings-btn (backend verified; UI navigation via sidebar 'CTA & Booking URL' link — sidebar-cta or similar testid). Book Now buttons are <button> elements (no href) that call window.open with cta.erp_booking_url — do not look for <a> hrefs when validating.
